setup: 120 task attempts per model. High effort, Fast mode for the September 29 cohort; Gemini uses high effort, standard mode, with verified replacements for two overheated attempts. GPT-6.1 Sol uses high effort and Fast mode, collected September 30–October 1 (Pacific); its scores are automated grades.
aggregation: Trial i contains all six tasks at original slot i, with redos replacing their original slots. Progress is the six-task mean; resources are six-task sums. Model values average 20 trials. Wall time is summed task duration, not concurrent elapsed time.
uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals; 50,000 resamples, seed 20260929. Aggregate intervals resample 20 six-task trials; task-bar intervals use 20 attempts for that task.
